description: "A medium-sized speaker system designed around an edgeless woofer based on the SLE system.A 20 cm cone type woofer using SLE method is mounted in the low range.In the SLE (Super Linear Long Excursion) system, the mechanical suspension (edge) is removed from the outer circumference of the cone paper, and excellent linearity is obtained. If this part is replaced with an equivalent circuit, it works like a port in a bass-reflex cabinet with a resonance point at a certain frequency. The acoustic low-pass filter is designed so that the resonance frequency is below the audible frequency. Therefore, this filter has a sufficiently large attenuation characteristic in the audible frequency, the gap can be completely ignored, the sound pressure before and after the cone paper does not short-circuit through the gap, and there is no sound pressure drop.The cone paper of Woofer is made of pulp material with sufficient rigidity, and special material with large internal loss is added for composite molding, which increases internal loss while maintaining rigidity.The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone scoker and the high-range is equipped with a 5 cm cone tweeter.The diaphragm of these units is a composite molding cone combined with a dome radiator.The enclosure is hermetically sealed.The exterior has a Eurasian cheek open pore finish."
